value.rationale: Natural graph-metric topology with a transitive translation group: ordinary sphere ranks miss the character, while the newly derived group modules determine all quotient rational positive homology. Order three kills every class despite two positive homology groups, whereas order four retains 18 top classes; the general closed formula gives natural invariants at every prime-power order. This is a complete structural module classification, not an arbitrary slice.
